data.name: SPARQ
data.detailed_description:
Jump into our ever-growing stack of games and fun experiences! Or, build them yourself!

A universe of multiplayer games.

SPARQ isn't just one game - it's a growing library of games, all in one place, and they're built to be played and created with other people. One minute you're plowing through a zombie horde with friends, the next you're shooting up rivals or beating a bunch of strangers in a cooking contest. Finish one, jump straight into the next. There's always something new to discover.

A new favorite every week.

We're constantly building new games - and so is a growing community of creators. The library grows all the time, so no two sessions are ever the same. The next game you fall in love with might not even exist yet.

  • Dozens of rich, pick-up-and-play games, all in one place

  • Fresh drops from our builders and team

  • Easy to use creator system for you to get going quickly

From two friends to a hundred strangers.

Almost everything in SPARQ is better with other people. Squad up in co-op, go head-to-head in PvP, or throw yourself into the chaos of 100+ player sessions. Bring your friends - or compete against strangers.

  • Any game mode: PvP, PvE, PvPvE.. Play and build whatever you feel like

  • Massive lobbies: Up to 100+ players, pure chaos

  • One identity across every game

Why stop at Play? Build.

SPARQ hands you the same tools we use to make our games - built to take you from idea to playable fast. Design, build, and publish your own, no manual coding required.

  • Describe it, build it by hand - or mix: Start from a text prompt and let AI rough out your game, then fine-tune every detail with drag-and-drop tooling.

  • Make real multiplayer games: Co-op, PvP, even 100+ players - without writing a single line of networking code. It's already handled.

  • A deep asset library: Characters, vehicles, environments, and props, ready to drop in and make your own.

  • Publish in one click: Share straight to the SPARQ community, and people can play your game immediately.

  • Easy to start, impossible to outgrow: Powerful enough for the real thing, simple enough to start today.

Share it with everyone, and maybe build the game the whole community is talking about next.

A note on AI in SPARQ: SPARQ's creation tools include optional AI assistance and MCP support for your favorite AI tools like Claude Code and Codex to help you build games faster - suggesting assets, layouts, and logic that you fully edit and control. You're always in the driver's seat.

Get in at the ground floor.

SPARQ is free to play and in Early Access, growing fast. Wishlist and follow now to be first as new games drop and the universe expands - and get in while the community's still small enough that the next big SPARQ game could be one you discover first, or one you build.

data.short_description: Play with friends - or 100+ players at once. SPARQ is a universe of multiplayer games, all in one place: co-op, PvP, total chaos. Smash zombie hordes, race rivals, win a tournament - then build your own and share it with everyone. No manual coding required.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 3600 / i5-9600K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
